verdict.rationale: Superpowers is a skills plugin and framework for coding agents. Versioning stability and a deprecation policy are fair questions for such a tool, so the axis applies. The pack has release notes describing changes, such as a renamed reference doc and a restructured workspace. It contains no evidence of versioned APIs or a documented deprecation policy.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can rely on versioned APIs with a documented deprecation policy
